name: relay
description: Writes a verified, secret-free session resume state as a local owner-only file outside git tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Write a verified, secret-free resume state at the end of a session.
interface.longDescription: Checks the draft state against branch, commit, pointed files, pull requests and tickets, refuses secrets, and writes an owner-only file outside git tracking. Unreadable facts are reported as unknown.
defaultPrompt: Write the resume state for this session.
